correctness.rationale: The exact elliptic-coordinate gradient reduces the global one-vertex problem to a polynomial inequality. Its sign is established by positive shifted coefficients for t>=1/2 and all 128 exact rational Bernstein coefficients for t in [0,1/2], with P2>=0. The moving-apex path and degeneracies are handled by squared-area vanishing; telescoping yields 9/32. A separate exact symbolic derivative gives the lower witness. The checker reproduces the critical identities and rational coefficients.

value.rationale: The motivating authors use simplex strength as a noise-stable scalar descriptor, with an explicit but conservative all-vertex coefficient 2 sqrt(3). The certified coefficient 9/32 improves the practical uniform guarantee by more than twelvefold, including degenerate triangles. The one-vertex constant is bracketed within 0.4% of the optimum and its finite rational proof is reusable for exact stability estimates.
